title: Diversifying Outlets
summary:
Diversifying Outlets
Arguments occasionally spawn diversification. Oil pipeline tariff squabbles with Belarus in 2008 prompted Russia to develop alternative routes that bypassed their neighbor. One result was the country's decision to build the Baltic Pipeline System 2 (BPS2) as shown in the following map.
